Kavita v0.9.1.0 is here for your digital library needs. This release brings a major Kavita+ overhaul with new audit logs, 10 security fixes, and Epub Variable Font Support. 📖

Best of all, the much-requested Series Rename functionality is back, plus a redesigned Cover Chooser with external sources.

Release: https://github.com/Kareadita/Kavita/releases/tag/v0.9.1.0
Run on PikaPods: https://pikapods.com/pods?run=kavita
#opensource #selfhosted
